name: AWS SES
description: Send emails through Amazon Simple Email Service (SES).

fields.name: authType
fields.description: How to authenticate with AWS: using static credentials or by assuming an IAM role.

fields.name: accessKeyId
fields.description: The AWS access key ID. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: secretAccessKey
fields.description: The AWS secret access key. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: roleArn
fields.description: The ARN of the IAM role to assume. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: The external ID used when assuming the IAM role. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: region
fields.description: The AWS region the SES service is configured in.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: A custom endpoint for the SES API. Leave empty to use the default AWS endpoint.

fields.name: fromEmail
fields.description: The email address that emails are sent from. Make sure it is a verified identity in SES.

fields.name: fromName
fields.description: The name shown as the sender of the emails.
